seed: M; not asserted superior to A; U excluded as parent
build: same existing GCC13.3.0 Makefile -O2 -g -fwrapv; assertions retained; no new LTO/PGO/padding
light_correctness: console smoke plus checks.js current value, layout, descriptor, prototype, proxy, exception, method receiver and temporary object cases; candidate-specific checks if lifecycle/storage changes

first_screen.order: A_before -> candidate -> A_after per case; seeded case order
first_screen.GM: all26 equal case geometric mean, no missing-case GM
first_screen.drift: max(A_before,A_after)/min(...) >1.10 = UNSTABLE; one full triple diagnostic; original stays primary; repeated drift triggers environment stop

priority: about >=5% whole-suite or larger mechanism-related per-case point estimate; 1-5% = tentative; any >10% regression prominent
octane_coarse: about every4 candidates or substantial coverage change; best current candidate plus A, all17 fixed cases, one fresh process each condition/case with A sandwich preferred
recheck: at most3 candidates; 3-5 interleaved full SunSpider rounds including same-batch A and parent; retain all rounds
metric: first-call-inclusive interpreter-mode execution; capture native monotonic performance.now before workload; no workload pre-run; Setup/static load outside; GC/builtins/dynamic frontend within original Run remain included
final_gate: only if correctness/recheck/complete Octane coarse acceptable; freeze one candidate and new data, all17 Octane A/candidate/V8_ON each30 fresh children and all26 SunSpider A/candidate each30; independent batch if clear benefit
aggregate: SunSpider equal cases; Octane core16/13suite and expanded17/14suite, within-suite GM then equal suites, Crypto fixed input, Box2D/official latency coverage limits retained
final_bootstrap: 10000 fixed-seed complete-round/paired groups; recompute medians and ratios; exploratory percentile95 unadjusted
raw: append-only runs.jsonl, process_start/result and linked measurement; boot/command/input/binary/script hash, N, stdout/stderr, exit, internal/outer monotonic intervals; no deleted outliers
environment: each performance campaign one boot and same identities; no compiler/diagnostic/other benchmark concurrency; host power/frequency/background UNKNOWN
search_stop: 12 actual candidates or one credible candidate fully explained and confirmed; environment failure saves partial records and recovery needs explicit checks, not an engine regression
never: invent improvement or CI for a single sample
